name: Qianfan (Spacesail) broadband satellite
note: Body frame: +Z nadir, +X velocity. A flat-panel bus (Qianfan satellites are flat panels stacked 18 to a Long March 6A) with one Sun-tracking array along +Y. Sizes and materials are ESTIMATES: the satellites' dimensions are unpublished; the array area is scaled from Starlink V1.5-class flat panels. LAUNCH (2026-10-20): 18 to a Long March 6A, two side by side per layer in a flat stack, nadir face down; the array an accordion pack folded over the zenith face.
